title: Privacy-Preserving Text Inference for Health-Misinformation Classification and Semantic Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.20796v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Health-misinformation analysis presents a dual challenge: misleading claims can affect public well-being, while systems designed to detect them may expose sensitive user-submitted text. This motivates privacy-preserving inference for public-health applications in which user queries may contain confidential medical information and trained models and reference databases are maintained on organizational servers. We design a privacy-preserving text inference framework based on CKKS homomorphic encryption for health-misinformation classification and semantic retrieval. The classification pipeline fuses BioBERT embeddings, PCA-reduced MPNet embeddings, and SVD-reduced TF-IDF features, while the retrieval pipeline combines MPNet embeddings with ISCC-SCT semantic fingerprints through late fusion. translated_title: 面向健康错误信息分类与语义检索的隐私保护文本推理
translated_abstract: 健康错误信息分析面临双重挑战：误导性言论可能影响公众健康福祉，而用于检测这些言论的系统可能会暴露用户提交的敏感文本。这促使人们为公共卫生应用设计隐私保护推理，其中用户查询可能包含机密医疗信息，而训练好的模型和参考数据库则保存在组织服务器上。我们设计了一个基于CKKS同态加密的隐私保护文本推理框架，用于健康错误信息分类和语义检索。分类管线融合了BioBERT嵌入、经PCA降维的MPNet嵌入以及经SVD降维的TF-IDF特征，而检索管线则通过后期融合将MPNet嵌入与ISCC-SCT语义指纹相结合。我们评估了预测性能，并对明文执行与基于密文的执行进行了基准测试。混合分类器达到了0.971的准确率，并且
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于CKKS同态加密的隐私保护文本推理框架，将BioBERT、MPNet与TF-IDF等特征融合用于健康错误信息分类（准确率达0.971），并结合语义指纹实现密文域上的语义检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a CKKS homomorphic encryption-based privacy-preserving text inference framework that fuses BioBERT, MPNet, and TF-IDF features for health-misinformation classification (achieving 0.971 accuracy) and enables semantic retrieval over encrypted data using semantic fingerprints.
